name: Pricing Service Tests
description: Test suite for the rate cache pricing service. Covers unit tests for rate calculation logic (seasonal overlaps, LOS discounts, fee/tax stacking), cache shard distribution tests, API contract tests, cache miss/hit path tests, serialization round-trip tests, and edge cases (zero-night stays, currency rounding, overlapping rate overrides). All monetary values use integer minor-unit (cents) arithmetic. The computation pipeline order is codified as: base rates → seasonal/override resolution → LOS discount → flat fees → percentage fees → taxes. Each pipeline step is a pure function, independently testable. Tests use Deno BDD style with injected mock RedisClient and RateRepository interfaces.

functions.name: resolve_nightly_rates
functions.description: Pure function (pipeline step 1-2): resolves nightly rates for each night in the date range using the 4-tier override system (BASE < SEASONAL < DATE_OVERRIDE < MANUAL_OVERRIDE). Higher-tier rates win. For overlapping seasonal rates, the one with higher priority wins. Tested in rate_calculation_test.ts.

error_cases.name: invalid_date_range
error_cases.condition: check_out <= check_in

error_cases.name: zero_night_stay
error_cases.condition: check_out == check_in (0 nights)

error_cases.name: overlapping_overrides_conflict
error_cases.condition: Multiple date overrides exist for the same date with different amounts

error_cases.name: currency_mismatch
error_cases.condition: A seasonal rate or override has a different currency than the config

preconditions: All seasonal_rates and date_overrides amounts share the same currency as rate_config.currency
postconditions: On success, result contains a NightlyRateList with exactly (check_out - check_in) entries in calendar order
Each NightlyRate has a source reflecting the highest-priority tier that matched
All returned Money amounts share the same currency as rate_config.currency

functions.name: apply_los_discount
functions.description: Pure function (pipeline step 3): applies the best matching length-of-stay discount to the accommodation subtotal. Selects the discount tier with the highest min_nights that the stay qualifies for. Tested in los_discount_test.ts.

inputs.name: num_nights
inputs.description: Number of nights in the stay.

error_cases.name: invalid_discount_config
error_cases.condition: LOS discount tiers have duplicate min_nights values

preconditions: los_discounts is sorted by min_nights ascending
postconditions: On success, result contains a Money value <= accommodation_subtotal
If no discount tier matches, returned amount equals accommodation_subtotal
Discount is calculated as floor(subtotal * discount_percent / 100) to avoid rounding up
Currency of result matches accommodation_subtotal.currency

functions.name: apply_flat_fees
functions.description: Pure function (pipeline step 4): computes and appends all flat fees. Flat fees are absolute amounts independent of accommodation total. Tested in fee_tax_test.ts.

inputs.name: fees
inputs.description: All configured fees (function filters to FLAT only).

error_cases.name: currency_mismatch
error_cases.condition: A flat fee is configured in a different currency

preconditions: All FLAT fees have amounts in the specified currency
postconditions: On success, result contains a LineItemList of FLAT_FEE line items
Each line item amount matches the fee's amount_minor exactly
All returned amounts use the specified currency

functions.name: apply_percentage_fees
functions.description: Pure function (pipeline step 5): computes percentage-based fees on the post-discount accommodation subtotal. Percentage is in basis points. Result is floor-rounded. Tested in fee_tax_test.ts.

inputs.name: fees
inputs.description: All configured fees (function filters to PERCENTAGE only).

inputs.name: base_amount
inputs.description: The accommodation subtotal after LOS discount, used as the fee base.

preconditions: All PERCENTAGE fee amounts represent basis points (0-10000)
postconditions: On success, result contains a LineItemList of PERCENTAGE_FEE line items
Each fee amount = floor(base_amount.amount_minor * fee.amount_minor / 10000)
All returned amounts use base_amount.currency

functions.name: apply_taxes
functions.description: Pure function (pipeline step 6): computes taxes on the taxable subtotal (accommodation after discount + taxable fees). Tax rate is in basis points. Result is floor-rounded. Tested in fee_tax_test.ts.

inputs.name: taxable_fees_total
inputs.description: Sum of fees marked as taxable.

error_cases.name: tax_rate_out_of_range
error_cases.condition: A tax rate_basis_points exceeds 10000

error_cases.name: currency_mismatch
error_cases.condition: accommodation_after_discount and taxable_fees_total currencies differ

preconditions: accommodation_after_discount and taxable_fees_total use the same currency
postconditions: On success, result contains a LineItemList of TAX line items
Each tax amount = floor(taxable_base * rate_basis_points / 10000)
Taxes that apply_to_fees use (accommodation_after_discount + taxable_fees_total) as base
Taxes that do not apply_to_fees use accommodation_after_discount only as base
All returned amounts use accommodation_after_discount.currency

functions.name: calculate_total
functions.description: Pipeline composition function: executes the full pricing pipeline (resolve_nightly_rates → apply_los_discount → apply_flat_fees → apply_percentage_fees → apply_taxes) and assembles an itemized PriceBreakdown. Tested across rate_calculation_test.ts, los_discount_test.ts, fee_tax_test.ts, and edge_cases_test.ts.

functions.name: compute_shard_index

error_cases.name: invalid_unit_id
error_cases.condition: unit_id is not a valid UUID v4

preconditions: unit_id is a valid UUID v4 string
postconditions: shard_index is in range [0, shard_count)

functions.name: check_shard_distribution
functions.description: Test utility: distributes a set of unit IDs across shards and reports uniformity. Used in cache_shard_test.ts to verify even distribution.

inputs.name: unit_ids
inputs.description: List of UnitId strings to distribute.

inputs.name: max_acceptable_deviation_percent
inputs.description: Maximum acceptable deviation from uniform distribution (e.g. 15.0 for 15%).

postconditions: counts_per_shard has exactly shard_count entries
Sum of counts_per_shard equals len(unit_ids)
is_uniform is true iff max_deviation_percent <= max_acceptable_deviation_percent

functions.name: lookup_price_with_cache
functions.description: Executes the cache-aware pricing lookup: checks Redis first (hit path), falls back to PostgreSQL via RateRepository on miss, writes back to cache on miss, then returns the computed PriceBreakdown. Uses injected RedisClient and RateRepository for testability. Tested in cache_path_test.ts.

inputs.name: cache_ttl_seconds
inputs.description: TTL for cache writebacks in seconds.

error_cases.name: shard_unavailable
error_cases.condition: Redis client is unavailable or fails

error_cases.name: repository_error
error_cases.condition: RateRepository fails on cache miss fallback

error_cases.name: cache_deserialization_error
error_cases.condition: Cached data fails to deserialize into valid rate structure

error_cases.name: rate_not_found
error_cases.condition: RateRepository returns no config for the unit_id

error_cases.name: invalid_unit_id
error_cases.condition: unit_id is not a valid UUID

postconditions: On HIT: redis_get_calls == 1, redis_set_calls == 0, repo_calls == 0
On MISS_THEN_WRITEBACK: redis_get_calls == 1, redis_set_calls == 1, repo_calls == 1, ttl_seconds == cache_ttl_seconds
On MISS_REPO_ERROR: redis_get_calls == 1, redis_set_calls == 0, repo_calls == 1, result is ResultErr
On DESERIALIZATION_ERROR: redis_get_calls == 1, result is ResultErr with CACHE_DESERIALIZATION_ERROR
On SHARD_UNAVAILABLE: result is ResultErr with SHARD_UNAVAILABLE
side_effects: May increment redis_client.set_call_count on cache writeback

invariants: All monetary amounts are represented as non-negative integers in minor currency units (cents). No floating-point money arithmetic is ever used.
CurrencyCode is always an uppercase ISO 4217 three-letter string (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR').
All entity IDs (UnitId, RateConfigId, RateOverrideId) are UUID v4 strings matching the pattern [0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}.
All date values (ISODateString) conform to ISO 8601 UTC format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.
The calculation pipeline is always applied in strict order: base rates → seasonal/override resolution → LOS discount → flat fees → percentage fees → taxes.
Shard assignment is deterministic: the same UnitId always maps to the same shard index for a given shard count.
Result types always contain exactly one of 'ok' value or 'error' value, never both and never neither.
Test fixture factories always produce valid domain objects with all required fields populated by sensible defaults.
Mock call counters are monotonically non-decreasing integers starting at zero.
PriceBreakdown line items sum exactly to the total field — no rounding drift is permitted.
